summary: Caution for pilots around Manchester and the Midlands about forecast low atmospheric pressure and the gap between local and standard pressure settings.
text:
CAUTION - LOW ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE IS FORECAST IN THE MANCHESTER
AND MIDLANDS AREA OF THE UK. ALL PILOTS, ESPECIALLY THOSE INBD TO
OR OUBD FM MANCHESTER, LIVERPOOL, HAWARDEN, LEEDS, BIRMINGHAM,
OXFORD, EAST MIDLANDS, COVENTRY, ISLE OF MAN, HUMBERSIDE, BLACKPOOL,
AND WARTON ARE TO EXER CTN WHEN DES OR CMB THROUGH THE TRL/ALT DUE
TO THE SIG DIFFERENCE BTN THE AD QNH AND THE STD PRESSURE SETTING.
